<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 3</cite> <he>מקום הדיי׳</he> the threshing place.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 69:5">Gen. R. s. 69</cite>, a. e. <he>מה עפר עשוי ד׳ לכל</he> as the dust is trodden upon by all.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 90b:9">B. Mets. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>לאו בדִישׁוֹ הוא</he> he did not muzzle it in the threshing place.
